phase: Independent read-only source review, before final SDK and beta gates

findings.finding: Selected-node display hints wait for all strict namechecks. Four parallel12-second callbacks can delay labels and later batches beyond24seconds. Publish display mappings independently.

findings.requirement: retain useful cached names through ordinary navigation/offline reading; make the separate provider dependency truthful
findings.finding: Both providers share a namespace containing the optional directory endpoint. Disabling the separate provider selects another cache file and loses selected-node labels while offline.

spec.scope: No unrequested scope; strict ownership verification and exact signing identity remain intact.

findings.finding: Other fixtures such as AvatarJourneyFixture and ActivityInboxFixture write the new shared displaynames family without retaining/restoring it. Capture this family centrally or in all affected fixtures.

standards.smellBaseline: No actionable smell heuristic. Frozen100 identities preserve99 additively, including the documented actual Chat StackPublic archive location.

disposition: All three findings accepted. Add actual native isolation regressions, separate provider stores, remove the ownership callback barrier, and preserve the shared cache family in every applicable fixture. Follow-up review and final execution required.
